_comment: faucet-stream connector registry — the index behind `faucet search` / `faucet install`. Built-in connectors are `verified` and ship in the `faucet` binary (enable with `--features <kind>-<name>`). Community connectors: open a PR adding an entry with `verified: false`, an explicit `crate`, and (optionally) a `feature`; users consume them by building a custom binary (see cli/README.md → Custom binaries with third-party connectors). `crate` defaults to `faucet-<kind>-<name>` and `feature` to `<kind>-<name>` when omitted. `tier` is the connector conformance maturity tier (stable/experimental/beta/draft, #330); for verified built-ins it is validated against the score computed by `faucet conformance` (see the `builtin_tiers_match_conformance` test), so it never drifts from the code. `title` is the display name and `category` one of databases/cdc/warehouses/streaming/files/apis/bridges (the Connector Hub groups by it, #572).
